name: self-test-node-typecheck-violation
description: C1 self-test fixture (review finding): deliberately failing typecheck script, no other scripts (same one-plausible-failure-point discipline as node-lint-violation) and zero dependencies (npm ci / npm audit both verified locally to succeed cleanly against it). Wired with an inverted assertion in self-test.yml, proving the reusable workflow's npm-typecheck step is a real blocking gate, not a swallow -- previously only pytest and npm-lint had this proof.
